title: E Pluribus Unum : Exploring the Effects of Billboarding on Consumer Brand Responses
authors: Zhe Zhang, Xiaoyan Deng, Matthew Thomson, Ning Ye

package_source.dataset_title: Replication Data for: E Pluribus Unum:  Exploring the Effects of Billboarding on Consumer Brand Responses

eligible_reason: Field and online experiments only. Study 1a is a farmers-market field experiment on sales (preregistered ANOVA / mixed model across test days, AsPredicted #106304), Study 1b a TikTok posting comparison, Study 1c an ad-click study; Studies 2-4 and Web Appendix E1-E3 are online experiments. No panel with staggered adoption.
design_notes: Zip extracted: per-study folders with SPSS .sav/.spv/.sps, Qualtrics PDFs, stimuli, IRB and AsPredicted PDFs; 'Read Me.docx' lists files by study.
screener_notes: Abstract mentions 'field data'; the package shows these are field experiments, not DiD.
main_text_note: Article confirms Study 1a is a two-cell (billboard vs control) farmers-market field experiment over four Saturdays, Study 1b a TikTok ad CTR test; no DiD terms.
